Default data_as_elements converts span and div with data-as

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
